summary: Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, reporting a routine change in the share count of its largest shareholder, Korea's National Pension Service (NPS). NPS's holdings decreased from 43,441,749 shares (9.15%) as of February 20, 2026, to 42,747,919 shares (9.01%) as of March 31, 2026. The disclosure is based on the shareholder registry closing date. There is no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal structure involved. The filing is a passive ownership update and does not constitute a special situation. No risk-arb angle exists.
